about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Learn about the history and mission of Grum Stove.
about.storyP1: Grum Stove was founded in 2014 with the goal of transforming the traditional stoves used by Ethiopian families into modern, economical and safe products.
about.storyP2: Starting from a small workshop, we have grown into a company with 4 branches in Addis Ababa and nearby areas. By serving thousands of customers, we have become a trusted name in the local market.
about.storyP3: We continue to prioritize our customers needs by offering quality products at affordable prices.
about.missionDesc: To improve the living standards of Ethiopian families by providing modern, economical and safe stoves at affordable prices.
about.visionDesc: To become the leading stove manufacturer in Ethiopia by 2020 and expand to the African market.
